entries.category_description: Restaurant and catering services, it being possible to exclude the supply of (alcoholic and/or non-alcoholic) beverages
entries.code_description: Meal serving services with full restaurant service
entries.comment: The reduced VAT rate is applied for restaurant and catering services, excluding alcoholic beverages as well as non-alcoholic beverages, falling within CN codes 2202. For details see art. 291 para. (2) letter n) of the Fiscal Code corroborated with point 37 para. (15) of the Methodological Norms.
